d:
Evy Poumpouras, former U.S. Secret Service Special Agent who spent over a decade protecting several American Presidents and served on the Presidential Protective Division for Barack and Michelle Obama, before becoming a trained interrogator, polygraph examiner, and behavioral expert.
She explains:
• How the Secret Service exam filters out nearly every candidate who attempts it
• What presidential security actually looks like inside a clean zone with counter-snipers and armored vehicles
• How Evy Poumpouras went from NYPD cop to the Presidential Protective Division for Barack and Michelle Obama
